title: 9041 Assignment 2
text:
Measures
Here is are the measures used: Social Interaction Anxiety Scale Questionnaire, Experiences in Close Relationships Anxiety Subscale Questionnaire, and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale Questionnaire. The Cronbach’s alphas for the scales are 0.9, 0.94, and 0.85, respectively.

title: 9041 Assignment 2
text:
Data Analysis Strategies
Items items 5, 9, and 11 were reverse coded for the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale responses, and items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 for Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale. This was done by adding a minus sign within the column name bracket (e.g., c(…“-SA_5”))
